snippet.title: Prey (2006) in VR (I can walk through the portals)
snippet.description:
Prey (2006) running in PCVR over OpenXR: real stereo, head tracking, portals you can walk through, and gravity you can walk on. Not a flat screen in a headset. This is Human Head's Prey, not the 2017 Arkane game.

This is a PCVR port of lvonasek's PreyVR, the Quest standalone build, brought across to Windows on Team Beef's Doom3Quest stack. Download (free, you must own Prey 2006): https://github.com/GameOrDie007/Prey-2006-VR
No game files are included. Extract the v1.0-pcvr zip anywhere, run Setup.bat once, then Play PreyVR.bat. Setup finds a Steam, GOG, or disc install, copies the .pk4 files, and builds the VR support pack from your own data. If it cannot find Prey, drag the folder that holds base\pak000.pk4 onto the Setup window.

Tested on Meta Quest 3 + Virtual Desktop (VDXR) at 90 Hz. OpenXR runtimes work. No headset? Play PreyVR flatscreen.bat runs it in a window.

Get an email when each new VR port ships (free, mods are never paywalled):
https://www.patreon.com/cw/GameOrDie

Join the Discord for news and testing:
https://discord.com/invite/tZdccWFpAc

Merch: Mugs, hoodies, wrapping paper and more: https://gameordie-shop.fourthwall.com

CHAPTERS
00:00 What this is
00:16 How to install
03:48 Starting The Game
08:42 Bar Games
09:26 Alien Abduction
11:50 Thank You

WHAT YOU NEED
• Windows PC + OpenXR headset
• Your own copy of Prey (2006), patched to 1.4
• Virtual Desktop or another OpenXR runtime
• The v1.0-pcvr release zip from GitHub

SETUP NOTES
• This is Prey 2006 (Human Head / 2K). The 2017 Arkane Prey will not work
• Prey 2006 is delisted on Steam. A disc, a GOG copy, or an old backup folder is the usual case
• Setup verifies every source file by SHA256 before it builds the VR pack
• Portals stop drawing their far side at distance; pcvr_portalDistance in autoexec.cfg controls that
• MSAA does nothing on PC. Use vr_supersampling instead

CREDIT
PreyVR by lvonasek
https://github.com/Team-Beef-Studios/PreyVR

Doom3Quest VR layer by Team Beef
https://www.teambeef.org/

Multithreaded d3es engine by emileb
id Tech 4 / Doom 3 GPL source by id Software
Prey (2006) by Human Head Studios and 2K Games

This is a community engine port, not an official VR release.

Game Or Die Twitch / YouTube / X: @GameOrDie007
GitHub: https://github.com/GameOrDie007/Prey-2006-VR
